title: The cohomology sheaves of the derived pullback of a quasi-coherent module on the blowup are annihilated by a fixed power of the ideal
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a power of the ideal, depending only on the ideal, that annihilates all the cohomology sheaves of the derived pullback of any module to the blowup, in degrees below the negative of the number of generators (author lemma at source lines 4642-4648, label lemma-annihilates). The proof (source lines 4650-4666) reduces the statement to an affine local computation on the standard covering of the blowup by the spectra of the affine blowup algebras, translates the required annihilation into the annihilation of the Tor modules of those algebras using the description of the derived pullback, and then quotes the affine statement, which is reproduced as a context span (proof lines 4651-4665). The reduction through the standard covering and the translation to Tor are the content. H2.
